name: Apollon ImGui
author: Apollon / ZEFF · reborn
description: Apollon for Minecraft Bedrock 1.26.66.1 (arm64-v8a). UI is now the LeviLaunchpad Mod Menu (no ImGui): the old ImGui surface could never appear because its only frame pump was a JNI entry point the game never calls. Features register as Mod Menu modules. 11/77 offsets are real recovered bodies; the rest are 0 and inert.
